name: clean_rooms
description: Start cleaning one or more chosen rooms with the Dreame vacuum. Call list_rooms first to get the room IDs. Does not choose the cleaning mode: when the user asks for a specific mode (for example to mop or to vacuum a room), call set_cleaning_mode before this tool. Uses the vacuum's current suction and water settings.

rooms.description: The IDs of the rooms to clean, as returned by list_rooms, for example [3, 5].
